list.title: Important Information
list.content: Bodywise’s Hair Growth Pack is developed by experts with safe & effective ingredients. In order to get long lasting results, you need to use this for at least 10 weeks..

list.title: Who should use this Advanced Hair Growth Pack?
list.content: These Biotin Gummies & Hair Growth Roll-On can be used by anyone who is experiencing hair loss, hair thinning and reduced hair volume. Use this pack for 10 weeks at least to see results.

list.title: How does the Hair Growth Pack work?
list.content: The Advanced Hair Growth Pack contains Hair Gummies and Rosemary Hair Growth Roll-On. Our Hair Gummies contain essential multivitamins like Biotin, Zinc, and Vitamin A, C, and E that are crucial building blocks of hair and help curb hair fall. Our all natural Hair Growth Roll-On contains plant-based actives that stimulate hair follicles leading to hair growth.

list.title: What is Biotin?
list.content: Our hair is made of a protein called Keratin. Having sufficient keratin is important to keep the hair strong. Biotin (B7) helps in keratin synthesis. It's a vital supplement for hair loss treatment.

list.title: How does Zinc help in hair fall?
list.content: Zinc plays an important role in hair tissue growth and repair. Having Zinc supplements help treat hair loss caused by insufficient zinc.

list.title: How is Hair Growth Roll On different than serums?
list.content: Hair Growth Roll On is much easier to use due to it's innovative roll-on form factor. It's mess free and ensures precise application

list.title: How does Rosemary help in Hair Growth?
list.content: Rosemary promotes hair growth by nourishing the scalp. It activates the dormant follicles leading to new hair growth. It also prevents hair fall by blocking DHT.

list.title: Is it oily?
list.content: Its non-oily, lightweight formula makes it suitable for everyday use without washing hair.

list.title: Will this pack help in hair loss?
list.content: Our Advanced Hair Growth Pack containing Biotin Hair Gummies & Hair Growth Roll-On is an effective and vital solution for hair loss treatment. By just taking one gummy everyday, and applying our roll on twice daily for 10 weeks, you can see visible reduction in hair fall and witness hair regrowth.

list.title: Is it safe for pregnant women?
list.content: Pregnant women should not use Hair Gummies without consulting an expert first.
